from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
import json

class Hou_Mcp_Agent_Plan(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_agent_plan"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("agent_id",          "string", widget_type="text",     default="")
        self.add_input("agent_name",        "string", widget_type="text",     default="scene_agent")
        self.add_input("supervision_level", "string", widget_type="text",     default="standard")
        self.add_input("prompt",            "string", widget_type="text",     default="")
        self.add_input("scene_context",     "any")
        self.add_input("context_json",      "string", widget_type="text",     default="{}")
        self.add_input("auto_register",     "bool",   widget_type="checkbox", default=True)
        self.add_output("ok",                   "bool")
        self.add_output("proposal_id",          "string")
        self.add_output("agent_id",             "string")
        self.add_output("intent",               "string")
        self.add_output("plan",                 "any")
        self.add_output("requires_approval",    "bool")
        self.add_output("execution_authorized", "bool")
        self.add_output("explanation",          "string")
        self.add_output("plan_json",            "string")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        from src.runtime.agent_runtime import get_agent_runtime
        _empty = {
            "exec_out": True, "ok": False, "proposal_id": "", "agent_id": "",
            "intent": "", "plan": {}, "requires_approval": True,
            "execution_authorized": False, "explanation": "", "plan_json": "{}"
        }

        prompt = str(inputs.get("prompt", "")).strip()
        if not prompt:
            _empty["explanation"] = "prompt is required"
            return _empty

        ar = get_agent_runtime()
        agent_id = str(inputs.get("agent_id", "")).strip()

        # Auto-register agent if needed
        if not agent_id and bool(inputs.get("auto_register", True)):
            agent_id = ar.register_agent(
                name=str(inputs.get("agent_name", "scene_agent")),
                supervision_level=str(inputs.get("supervision_level", "standard")),
            )

        if not agent_id:
            _empty["explanation"] = "agent_id required (or set auto_register=true)"
            return _empty

        try:
            ctx_raw = inputs.get("context_json") or "{}"
            context = json.loads(ctx_raw) if isinstance(ctx_raw, str) else {}
        except Exception:
            context = {}

        scene_ctx = inputs.get("scene_context")
        if isinstance(scene_ctx, dict):
            context.update(scene_ctx)

        try:
            result = await ar.submit_proposal(agent_id, {"prompt": prompt, "context": context})
        except Exception as exc:
            _empty["explanation"] = f"proposal error: {exc}"
            return _empty

        sup = result.get("supervision_result", {})
        return {
            "exec_out":             True,
            "ok":                   bool(result.get("ok", False)),
            "proposal_id":          str(result.get("proposal_id", "")),
            "agent_id":             str(result.get("agent_id", agent_id)),
            "intent":               str(result.get("intent", "")),
            "plan":                 result.get("plan", {}),
            "requires_approval":    bool(result.get("requires_approval", True)),
            "execution_authorized": bool(result.get("execution_authorized", False)),
            "explanation":          str(result.get("explanation", "")),
            "plan_json":            str(result.get("plan_json", "{}")),
        }

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Agent_Plan
